Hi Anika — thanks for the clear list. Putting a concise plan below and looping in Product and Security to confirm operational constraints.

Summary (short):
- Primary customer data (live DB and object store): standard deletion request executes within 72 hours of receiving signed termination + identity verification; final irreversible wipe completed within 14 days.
- Snapshot/backups: default retention is 90 days for daily snapshots. We can do an accelerated purge for account-owned snapshots within 14 days if no active legal hold or ongoing investigations. That purge includes removal of object-store snapshots and marking of related metadata entries for deletion.
- Encrypted backups / KMS: We delete per-customer KMS keys on request after data deletion if the customer confirms no longer needing exported key material; key destruction timing is 7 days after final approval to allow last-minute restores.
- Audit/log retention: API request logs and tracing are retained for 180 days by default. We can offer a policy to reduce to 30 days for customers under a custom agreement, but this requires Product approval and a change to our logging pipeline and retention TTLs.

Dependencies and exceptions:
- Legal hold: if Legal places a hold, we will not purge until hold is lifted and will preserve an immutable copy for the hold window.
- Subprocessors: some backups (cross-region replication and cloud-provider snapshots) may rely on cloud provider retention windows and require coordination with their subprocessor teams.
- Forensic requests: if a forensic export is requested, we must complete exports prior to purge.

Operational ask to MedTech: please provide a signed termination letter and confirm whether you want KMS key destruction. If you request accelerated purge, we will provide a one-off DocuSign amendment to the DPA and a short runbook showing steps and timelines.

I’ll coordinate the DocuSign and an internal accelerated-purge runbook. cc: Lauren and Marcus for final sign-off on log TTL and snapshot purge runbook.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Clarify post-termination backups & accelerated purge request

Chloe — quick technical confirmation from Product/Infra.

Notes: 
- Snapshots: our nightly snapshot system creates incremental snapshots that reference base images. Full irreversible cleanup of all snapshot layers requires a GC pass that runs weekly; we can prioritize a targeted GC for a single account which reduces the effective cleanup to within 7 calendar days (vs. default 30+). That will remove incremental references and free object-store objects.
- Cross-region replicas: if MedTech has replication enabled, cloud-provider retention policies may keep a replica for up to 14 additional days; we will request expedited delete from the subprocessor (cloud provider) but cannot guarantee sub-day deletion.
- Logs: reducing from 180 -> 30 days is possible but requires updating the logging TTL in two places (ingest pipeline and long-term cold archive). That work is low-risk but will require a short change window (approx 48 hours) and a signed change request.

Proposed operational offer to MedTech:
1) Standard: 90-day snapshot retention, 180-day logs (no action).
2) Accelerated purge (customer-requested): targeted GC + snapshot purge within 7 days, KMS key scheduled for destruction 7 days post-final sign-off, and logs reduced to 30 days after a 48-hour config window. This requires: signed termination, DocuSign amendment (we prepare), and confirmation that no legal hold exists.

I can prepare the targeted GC runbook and timeline if Lauren signs off.

— Marcus
Director, Product Ops
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
